title: A triangular dysprosium with asymmetric central caps featuring ferromagnetic coupling and single-molecule magnet behaviour

material_class.structural_family: triangular Dy3 capped asymmetrically by one μ3-OH and one μ3-alkoxyl group

synthesis.procedure: To 3-p-methoxyaniline-5-methoxysalicylaldehyde (0.057 g, 0.2 mmol) in ethanol (15 mL) was added 2-aminoethanol (0.8 mL, 0.8 mmol) in a 1:4 molar ratio, and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 30 min. Dy(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.114 g, 0.2 mmol) was then added and the solution was stirred at room temperature for 2 h and left for slow evaporation. Colourless single crystals of complex 2 formed after one month. H2L in the isolated cluster is the decomposition product of the in situ Schiff-base ligand H2L′.
synthesis.time: 30 min ligand condensation, then 2 h after addition of Dy salt; crystals after one month
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The solution was left unperturbed for slow evaporation of ethanol; colourless single crystals were obtained after one month.

properties.summary: DC susceptibility indicates dominant intramolecular ferromagnetic Dy–Dy coupling, in contrast to the diamagnetic ground state of the related di-μ3-OH triangle. Frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility under zero dc field shows SMM behaviour, with a thermally activated barrier above about 5 K and a crossover toward a tunneling process below about 4.5 K.
